cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Calm About the Impossible
cards.instruction: Remain perfectly calm around impossible events while becoming increasingly alarmed by ordinary details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your dragon can stay for tea. Please keep the biscuit crumbs off my carpet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His three heads breathe fire. Should I take him outside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. He's fine here. Wait, three mouths? I need three napkins immediately.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He brought his own. They're paper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paper? At my good table? Fetch the linen before the neighbors see.

mechanism: A claims authority to decide what stays or moves while calmly admitting impossibility and urgently controlling ordinary household standards.
confusable: Generic controlling fussiness is confusable: A must explicitly accept the extraordinary event while anxiety rises only over mundane cleanliness or etiquette.
comparison: Dragon tea makes A the host with a visitor; floating-table packing makes A control a helper proposed physical remedy.
seedUse: Read both canonical Stance and both Drive seeds. Their host permission and object-handling orders already enact authority; retain when the exact original remains strong, trimming only demonstrated redundant material if needed.
